concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑013 (record artifact hashes and versioning information in state/projects/PROJ-250‑neural‑correlates‑of‑temporal‑prediction.yaml) is not satisfied by any task. The task matrix claims FR‑013 is covered by T001, but T001 only writes checksums to data/raw/checksums.json and never updates the state YAML, leaving the version‑ing discipline requirement unimplemented.

Success Criterion SC‑004 (topographic consistency and validity correlations must meet r ≥ 0.8) is not enforced. T005b computes Pearson r and stores it, but the task description does not specify aborting or flagging when the threshold is not met, so a failure to meet the criterion could go unnoticed.
